title: Screen: drying time left is rounded up (05min, 04min ... 01min instead of 04 ... 00)
note: The drying countdown label was computed with floor division, so a 5-minute drying started at '04min' and showed '00min' for its whole last minute. The 9 instructions that compute the value now call a 15-instruction helper in the program's added code section: above one hour it shows hours rounded up ('02h' means up to 2 hours), from one hour down it shows minutes rounded up (60min ... 01min). The 'drying finished' check still uses the exact seconds.
